reader_summary.headline: Arjun Sethi is Co-founder and CEO of Tribe Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Arjun Sethi is Co-founder and CEO of Tribe Capital. Arjun was an entrepreneur who founded and sold two businesses and became an active angel investor before turning to venture capital. Our conversation covers Arjun's upbringings in an immigrant family, his early endeavors as an entrepreneur, success as an angel investor.
